scope: Actual Anakin deployment pipelines and native unitree_cpp backend on official unconstrained floating G1 over loopback DDS. This is simulation evidence, not physical-hardware certification.
provenance_note: Historical trials span the documented fixes; delivered_source_sha256 describes delivered code, not a reconstructed source hash for each historical trial. Diagnostics that bypassed legacy blend are excluded from formal trials. Raw logs remain under the ignored logs directory; their SHA256 and compact summaries are retained here.

coverage.h1_scope: Offline checkpoint inference only; G1 runner rejects H1. H1 real config additionally lacks unitree_sdk2py.
